newsitem.title: USA: Tesoro sees Q4 gain to end Tenn. contract.
newsitem.headline: Tesoro sees Q4 gain to end Tenn. contract.

text.p: Tesoro Petroleum Corp said Thursday it agreed to allow Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company to terminate its gas purchase contract, effective Oct. 1, 1996.
The contract termination is expected to allow Tesoro to record an after-tax gain of about $1.41 per share in the fourth quarter from ending a gas purchase contract with Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co.
The after-tax gain of roughly $38 million is part of an agreement to end the contract, which was originally to expire in January 1999, Tesoro said.
The agreement to end the contract is part of a settlement ending a lawsuit Tennessee Gas filed against Tesoro, KCS Energy Inc and Coastal Corp.

The suit claimed Tesoro and the two other companies had acted in bad faith when they increased production in a South Texas natural gas field covered by a 1979 purchase contract. Under the contract's terms, Tennessee Gas ended up paying above-market prices of more than $8 per thousand cubic feet for the gas it purchased.
Tenneco Energy, the parent of Tennessee Gas Pipeline, was sold to El Paso Energy Corp from Tenneco Inc.
